settings.title: Settings
settings.placeholder: "{category}" settings are planned for a later phase

general.languageHint: English is the default. Changes apply immediately (no restart). Chinese, Spanish, French, and German are planned.

agent.providerHint: Uses your existing subscription sign-in. No API key is needed (authentication is delegated to the Claude Code CLI sign-in).
agent.cliMissingHint: Check that {command} works in a terminal, or set a path in "Claude executable" below.
agent.autoApproveDesc: Claude keeps editing the drawing without confirmation. Every edit can be undone (always on in A1)
agent.autoReadDesc: Shares the project and netlist when a conversation starts
agent.claudePathHint: Path to the claude executable used instead of auto-detection. Leave empty to return to auto-detection.
agent.knowledgeHint: Markdown file with your own standards and house rules. It is appended after the bundled standards note, so it can override them. Leave empty to use the bundled note only.
agent.knowledgeClearedLog: Settings: knowledge file cleared (bundled standards note only)
agent.pathClearedLog: Settings: claude path reset to auto-detection

revisions.title: Edit revision table
revisions.note: ISO 7200 / JIS Z 8311: the table sits directly above the title block and stacks from old at the bottom to newest at the top.
revisions.hint: Marks advance automatically (A, B, C ...). Saving runs one command (undoable) and updates the revision table and the title block Rev.
revisions.empty: No revisions yet. Use "+ Add revision" to add the first one.
revisions.savedLog: Revision table: saved {count} row(s) (undo with Cmd+Z)
revisions.noSheetLog: Revision table: no sheet is open

wireNumbers.title: Automatic wire numbering
wireNumbers.note: IEC 62491: one number per net. It is drawn once at a representative spot on the drawing and follows through to the wire list.
wireNumbers.zoneDisabled: Zone based numbering is planned for a later phase (M4)
wireNumbers.zoneDisabledLog: Wire numbers: zone based numbering is planned for a later phase (M4)
wireNumbers.startInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
wireNumbers.existingKeep: Keep them (number only what has none)
wireNumbers.doneSheetLog: Wire numbers: numbered {count} net(s) on "{sheet}" (undo with Cmd+Z)
wireNumbers.doneProjectLog: Wire numbers: numbered {count} net(s) across the project (undo with Cmd+Z)
wireNumbers.noSheetLog: Wire numbers: no sheet is open
wireNumbers.invalidLog: Wire numbers: the start number must be a whole number of 1 or more
wireNumbers.setLog: Wire numbers: wire number set to {number} (undo with Cmd+Z)
wireNumbers.clearedLog: Wire numbers: wire number cleared (undo with Cmd+Z)

harness.startLog: Harness: drag a rectangle around the wires to enclose (Esc to cancel)
harness.createdLog: Harness: created {name} enclosing {count} wire(s) (undo with Cmd+Z)
harness.nameHint: Harness name (W1, W2 ...). It appears in the harness column of the wire list.
harness.wireCountHint: exported in the wire list as {name}
harness.wireCountHintUnnamed: name it to have it exported in the wire list

xref.propertyHint: Sheets and zones where the same net label continues. Click an address to jump there.
xref.noneHint: no same-named net label on another sheet

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.undoHint: Applying is a single edit, so one Cmd+Z takes it back if it does not fit.
templates.folderOpenedLog: Templates: opened {path} (drop .json files there to see them listed)
templates.folderHintLog: Templates: drop .json files into {path} to see them listed

reports.title: Generate report
reports.note: Reports are derived from the drawing every time they are generated; they are never edited by hand.
reports.targetHint: The terminal chart and the connection diagram can be limited to one terminal block.
reports.formatHint: The drawing sheet is an A4 landscape page with the JIS frame and title block, split over pages as needed.
reports.diagramPdfOnly: The connection diagram is a drawing, so it comes as a PDF only.
reports.pathPlaceholder: Absolute path of the output file

pdfBook.title: Export the whole drawing set as one PDF
pdfBook.note: Page order: cover (project name, sheet list, latest revision), every schematic sheet, then the reports you pick.
pdfBook.openLog: PDF book: pick the reports to bind after the schematics

terminals.title: Terminal strip editor
terminals.noBlocks: This sheet has no terminal block yet. Place one from Insert part.
terminals.jumperHint: Select neighbouring terminals and add a saddle jumper. Every edit goes through a command, so Cmd+Z takes it back.
terminals.hint: The grid is derived from the drawing (wiring, wire numbers and wires cannot be edited here). The inside of the panel is the left connection point, the outside is the right one.
terminals.openLog: Terminal editor: editing the terminal blocks of "{sheet}"
terminals.noSheetLog: Terminal editor: no sheet is open
terminals.noBlockLog: Terminal editor: this sheet has no terminal block
terminals.jumperAddedLog: Terminal editor: jumper {jumper} added to {reference} (undo with Cmd+Z)
terminals.jumperRemovedLog: Terminal editor: jumpers on terminal(s) {terminals} of {reference} removed (undo with Cmd+Z)
terminals.chartLog: Terminal editor: wrote the chart of {reference} ({count} row(s)) to {path}
terminals.diagramLog: Terminal editor: wrote the connection diagram of {reference} ({count} page(s)) to {path}
